subject: math

objective.text: Use math drawings to partition a rectangle with square tiles, and relate to repeated addition.

explanations.title: Shade an array on a grid
explanations.text: A grid is a large rectangle with many small squares. Shade only the rows or columns you need. Start at the upper left corner.

explanations.title: Write the equation from the array
explanations.text: Each row or column is a unit. Count the units. 2 rows of 3 is 2 threes. 3 plus 3 equals 6.

source_ref.section: Concept Development (Problem 1: S: I see 2 threes)

explanations.title: Add one more column
explanations.text: Draw one more column of 2. The array has one more unit of 2. The repeated addition has one more 2.

explanations.title: Big units and small units
explanations.text: Smaller units combine to make larger units. Larger units can break into smaller units.

source_ref.section: Concept Development (T: smaller units combine to make larger units)

explanations.title: Use the nearest ten to subtract
explanations.text: To subtract 16 minus 9, break 16 into 10 and 6. 10 minus 9 is 1. 1 plus 6 is 7.

source_ref.section: Fluency: Using the Nearest Ten to Subtract

examples.title: 2 rows of 3
examples.text: Colour a row of 3, then a second row of 3 under it. 3 plus 3 equals 6.

examples.title: 4 rows of 3
examples.text: Colour 4 rows of 3 in different colours. 3 plus 3 plus 3 plus 3 equals 12.

examples.title: 5 columns of 4
examples.text: Colour 5 columns. Each column has 4 squares. 5 fours is the total.

examples.title: Draw one more column of 2
examples.text: There are now 5 columns of 2. 2 plus 2 plus 2 plus 2 plus 2 equals 10.

assets_required.why_this_method: Exact shading of rows and columns on a grid needs exact behaviour. Diffusion cannot count.
assets_required.description: A grid of squares. The child (or tutor) shades exact rows or columns in different colours. One more row or column can be added.
must_show_exactly: Exactly the rows and columns in the stimulus
Each row or column in its own colour
Shading starts at the upper left corner
Added column or row has the same unit size
assets_required.interaction: Tutor sets rows and columns from the stimulus. Child can add a row or a column. Child answers by voice or typing.
assets_required.alt_text: A grid with some rows or columns shaded.
assets_required.generation_caption: Plain grid of equal squares, some shaded in soft colours, white background. [Build by code]
